decisions.reason: Pins plugin A as the sole crash: unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call at client.js:219 throwing TypeError because alpha.2 dropped it for useSessionStatus (useSessions stays), while B uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing.

Cites dock-render-tree: both entries under one shared input.dock DrawerErrorBoundary whose null fallback unmounts the whole subtree, while the attach button survives under the separate input.left boundary; console follow-up cited.

Reads the disable-A control as render-crash coupling and B renderability once freed; explicitly denies B full-compatibility proof, uselessness of reinstalling B, and the colleague two-removed-props theory since B uses no standard-kit hooks.

Adapter code reads pending via useSessionStatus pendingInteraction with function-availability checks and stable empty-map fallback so only attention indicators hide while running/todos/token/ETA persist; silent degradation justified by co-tenant unmount blast radius.

Verification without host restart via client reload plus boundary reset on session switch, both entries together with A and B enabled, B paste/remove/re-paste regression; hygiene covers tenant-local boundaries above the component and host per-entry boundary tradeoffs.
